Thakurgaon was freed on this day in 1971
2016-12-03T00:00:00+06:00 | Our Correspondent, Thakurgaon
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/thakurgaon-was-freed-day-1971-1324366

Thakurgaon was liberated from the Pakistani occupation forces on this day in 1971.

A heavy gun battle took place on December 1 night, 1971,  between freedom fighters and Pakistani forces.

Failing to resist freedom fighters and allied forces, the occupation forces started to leave the town from December 2 morning. They completed withdrawal by that night and took shelter at Saidpur Cantonment.

Next morning, the freedom fighters entered the town. Hearing the news, people from all walks of life came out on the streets in the town chanting slogan “Joy Bangla” with freedom fighters.

During the war period a large number of innocent people were killed by the Pakistani forces and their collaborators in Thakurgaon.

Rickshaw puller Mohammad Ali was the first martyr of the Liberation War in Thakurgaon. He was shot dead by Pakistani army on March 27.

District unit of Bangladesh Muktijoddha Sangshad and of Bangladesh Udichi Shilpi Gosthi have jointly arranged different programmes including placing wreaths on the martyrs' monuments, bringing out colourful procession titled “Mukti Shovajatra” in the town.  Discussion on the Liberation War, drama and cultural programme will also be held at the district's Central Shaheed Minar.
